text:
God is saying to you today,
"Never give up on your dreams.
I am faithful. I am going to restore
you. I am going to heal you.
I am going to make a way for you.
I did it before and I will do it again.
Stay in prayer and remain faithful.
I am the same yesterday, today, and
forever. I will never change."
